notes: Hardener made no code changes (worktree clean after removing a uv.lock the test run generated). Gaps for the owner: (1) P5 says 'descriptions and profile'; the case profile does not exist until C3 lands, so only descriptions, path and account name are sentinel-tested. Extend test_no_prompt_carries_line_level_text when case.yaml exists. (2) R29 'open no network connection other than the loopback workspace' is enforced for the two hosted clients and the MCP server only. Nothing yet guards later network code, such as a future importer fetching a feed. A process-wide guard is a design call. (3) Library callers can still do `from cma.mcp_server import server; server.run()` and skip main(). Supported launches (python -m, the mcp CLI) cannot. Moving the check into server start-up (a lifespan hook) would close it. (4) R34's escaping and CSV-formula parts belong to C5/C6, not this task; only the 'never send it to a model' part is covered here. (5) Turning the lock off is recorded per evidence record (egress), not as its own event. The case log that would record it is C3. (6) Changelog line: the repo has no CHANGELOG. The README text is the user-facing note. (7) The rollback (offline_lock: false) was tried only in tests and the CI step, not in a non-production deploy, because there is none.
